note: The script asks for four graphics: the hook text, the name super, one key-word top text and a three-line word stack, then the CureGRIN end card. The super's second line is typed by the editor under the name. No CureGRIN logo file yet: the end card types the name until Lauren's high-res logo arrives.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: STILL WAITING ON YOUR CHILD'S VARIANT?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, big and bold, top third: “STILL WAITING ON YOUR CHILD'S VARIANT?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third, big and bold.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:04–00:06, small, lower left, above the captions: “Bruce Leuchter” / “CEO, GRIN Therapeutics”.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:04 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line “CEO, GRIN Therapeutics” under the name.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words, top text at 00:26 for 2 s, as he says them: “That requires variant characterization.”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:26, on his words, for 2 s in the top band. Keep the captions on.

mg.title: Who is working on it
mg.cue: Key words stack in, top, as he says them, from 00:39 for 6 s: “the broader ecosystem” / “the principal investigators” / “the basic scientists”.
mg.use: Start it at 00:39. Slide each phrase in on his word, in the top band, over the B-roll. Keep the captions on.

mg.title: End card
